assessment: This important study uses AlphaFold2 to predict the structures of bacterial protein complexes that the authors classify as "essential". The evidence supporting the conclusions is convincing, as the authors have tested the approach on an external dataset of 140 experimentally solved bacterial protein-protein complexes, 81% of which were predicted with high accuracy. This paper will be of general interest to a wide audience in the field of biosciences and in particular for molecular biologists.
